vetSays.line: 🛡️ Easton, Jack, Olga and Theo met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Easton, Jack, Olga, Theo are hurt.
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Ella taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.

Theo has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Ella is showing everyone European Elder by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The Codex grows — the human way.
🛡️ Easton, Irving, Jack and Olga met them at the door — 4 put down. Easton, Irving, Jack, Olga are hurt.
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Easton was watching. Now they know Ground Elder too.
🌿 European Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 European Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
Easton showed Sigrun the Ground Elder — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.
Stella showed Onni the Ground Elder — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
🛡️ Easton, Jack, Olga, Esmeralda and Theo met them at the door — 5 put down. Easton, Jack, Olga, Esmeralda, Theo are hurt.
Jack showed Ella the Ground Elder — "remember it." Word gets around.
Theo: "Walked past a good stand of ground elder. Worth remembering where."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Easton just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Easton, Giulia, Sigrun and Onni met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 2 barely walked away. Easton, Giulia, Sigrun, Onni are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Easton just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Onni just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Easton, Esmeralda, Giulia, Sigrun and Onni met them at the door — 2 put down, 3 driven off. Easton, Giulia, Onni are hurt.
Onni: "The ground elder patch is fruiting again. Somebody should get out there."
🌿 European Elder, weeks in the baskets. Handling it day after day, the village has learned what it's FOR — not just what it is. The village knows its uses now.
💡 European Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Easton just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sigrun just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Easton, Giulia, Sigrun and Onni met them at the door — 2 put down, 2 driven off. Giulia, Sigrun, Onni are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Donatella just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Donatella and Carlos met them at the door — 2 put down. Donatella, Carlos are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
The Scarred The Ugly Beast falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred The Ugly Beast!
🛡️ Donatella, Kiem and Carlos met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Donatella, Kiem, Carlos are hurt.
💬 Rómulo has been asking you about Cold-Blooded — what it does, what it goes with. Planning something.
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader The Moderator (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
The Pack-leader The Moderator falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Pack-leader The Moderator!
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tom just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mai just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Tom, Rómulo, Antônio and Mai met them at the door — 4 put down. Tom, Rómulo, Antônio, Mai are hurt.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
